research.title: What should Reely look for?
research.subtitle: Describe your niche in a sentence or two. Reely turns it into searches and ranks what's outperforming.
research.describeHint: Write it however it comes out. Reely will suggest search keywords next.
research.briefPlaceholder: e.g. Online accounting software for Thai SMEs and accounting offices. Find videos about bookkeeping tips, tax deadlines and accounting tools. Avoid stock trading content.

brief.angleExample: e.g. quick tips, reviews, tax news

research.searchForHint: Reely runs each selected keyword on every platform you pick. Tap to select up to 5.
research.filterOutHint: Videos whose caption mentions any of these are dropped before you see them.
research.creditEstimate: Uses about {credits} TikTok credits. YouTube is free.
research.runningHint: Finding videos, checking each creator's usual views and writing your summary. Usually under a minute.
research.sampleNotice: Gemini key not set yet, so these keywords come from your brief as written.
research.errorRun: The research couldn't finish. Try again in a moment.

results.failed: This research didn't finish. Some results may be missing.

results.tileSmall: top results from accounts under 10K followers

video.hypothesisNote: AI explanation based on the caption and numbers — a hypothesis, not a fact.
